description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map3, Alchemilla Hospital: the fog hospital before and after Kaufmann (map3_s00, map3_s01), the antique shop cutscene (map3_s02), the Otherworld hospital (map3_s03 3F and 2F, map3_s04 1F, map3_s05 basement) and the hospital after it (map3_s06): keys, doors, the plate door, the Bloodsucker room, cutscenes, pickups.

M3S00_HospitalEntered.description: Set the first time Harry goes through the door at map3_s00 point 3 (button, room load to point 2). It starts FMV 13 (event 1) and so Kaufmann's hospital scene; the map2_s00 music mix also adds a layer in room 33 until it is set.

M3S00_HospitalFmvSeen.description: Completion flag of FMV 13, played right after Harry first enters the hospital (M3S00_HospitalEntered). It starts the Kaufmann scene (map3_s00 event 2, CutsceneKaufmannHospital).

M3S00_KaufmannCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the Kaufmann scene in the hospital lobby (map3_s00 CutsceneKaufmannHospital). The hospital music mix (map3_s00/s01/s06) changes once it is set.

M3S00_KaufmannBagTaken.description: Set when Kaufmann picks up his bag in the hospital scene (his animation passes keyframe 139 and his mesh swaps) and again at the end of the scene. While clear, the bag model (TRUNK_HI) is drawn on the floor of map3_s00.

M3S00_FirstAidKit.description: Odd numbering not with other common items, possibly some default that goes unused. Shared with M3S01 and M3S06.

M3S00_WestPathSoundPlayed.description: One-shot sound in map3_s00: while Harry is in the 40 m cell x 0..40 / z 120..160 west of x = 24 m, each tick may play Sfx_Unk1492 (sound 'kaufmann_shot' in sounds.json) at (22.5, -1.5, 137.0), the more likely the closer he is to x = 24 m. Playing it sets this flag, so it never repeats.

M3S01_SeenFirstNewspaper.description: Set when Harry reads the hospital newspaper (NEWSP1.TIM, 'There is a newspaper') in map3_s01 or map3_s06. Norman's Motel (map5_s03 events 5-7, SecondNewspaperRead) offers the second newspaper only once it is set.

M3S01_SeenShatteredVial.description: Set after Harry examines the shattered glass vial in the hospital (map3_s01 MapEvent_UnknownLiquidInteract, SHATVIAL.TIM, 'A glass vial lies shattered.'). In the map5_s03 garage scene with Kaufmann, the extra remark comparing his vial to the busted one is shown only when it is set.

M3S01_PickupPlasticBottle.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the plastic bottle on map3_s01 (Hospital - 1F and basement after Kaufmann) at map point 62 (x 22.8, z 58.2 m), event 16; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M3S01_PickupUnknownLiquid.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the unknown liquid on map3_s01 (Hospital - 1F and basement after Kaufmann) at map point 57 (x 141.6, z 20.8 m), event 4; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M3S01_PickupBasementKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the basement key on map3_s01 (Hospital - 1F and basement after Kaufmann) at map point 65 (x 99.9, z 58.2 m), event 19; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M3S01_BasementDoorOpen.description: Set when the basement key is used on the basement door of Alchemilla Hospital, 1F (map3_s01, events 42/43, "Used the basement key."); the map also marks the stairs door with arrows. In the base data nothing else reads it, so it only stops the key-use event from repeating.

M3S01_GeneratorOn.description: Set when Harry presses the switch of the in-house generator in the hospital basement (map3_s01, event 20). It powers the hospital elevator (the elevator events on every floor require it), starts the generator hum and rumble, and adds a music layer in two hospital rooms (rooms 17 and 20).

M3S01_ElevatorExtraFloorChosen.description: Set when Harry presses the extra button of the fog hospital elevator panel (button 5 of map3_s01). The button exists only on the ELEVAT_2.TIM panel, shown when MapMark_FogHospital2F_NearElevatorBroken and MapMark_FogHospital3F_NearElevatorBroken are both set. It opens map3_s01 event 41, the door to map3_s02 (Alessa on the stairway, then the lights go out).

M3S04_KnockingBehindDoorHeard.description: Set after the scene at the locked door at map3_s04 point 5 (Otherworld hospital 1F): sounds behind the door and the message 'A sound is heard from...'. Afterwards the door only says it is locked.

M3S02_CorridorDoorNoiseHeard.description: One-shot in map3_s02: when Harry walks south of z = -129 m in the first corridor, a sound (Sfx_Unk1523) plays at the door at point 4 (100.0, -127.2) and the flag is set. From then on that door gives map3_s02 event 9 ('It's locked!').

M3S02_DarkRoomDoorNoiseHeard.description: One-shot in map3_s02: after Harry arrives at point 11 (69.6, -138.4) through the door at point 5 and moves west of x = 67 m, a sound (Sfx_Unk1523) plays at that door and the flag is set. From then on that door gives map3_s02 event 12 ('It's locked!').

M3S02_DarkRoomEntered.description: Set when Harry first goes through the map3_s02 door at point 5 (room load to point 11). It starts MapEvent_LightsGoOut (event 16).

Nothing in the game sets it (an EventCallback without transition flags does not set its completion flag), so the event stays available; its only effect would be to disable examining the door without a plate.

M3S05_CabinetPushed.description: Set when Harry pushes the cabinet aside in the Otherworld hospital basement (map3_s05, event 17). The cabinet then stays moved, and the doors behind it (events 37/38) can be used.

M3S05_AlcoholPouredOnVines.description: Set after the disinfecting alcohol is used on the vines at the grate in the Otherworld hospital basement (map3_s05, event 14). It allows setting the vines on fire with the lighter (event 12, sets M3S05_VinesBurned) and changes their inspect message.

M3S05_VinesBurned.description: Set when Harry burns the vines with the Lighter after pouring the alcohol on them (map3_s05 Cutscene_BurnVines). It opens the way at point 18 (event 11), turns off the fire effect of map3_s05 and swaps the vine objects.

M3S05_CabinetNotPushedYet.description: Kept up to date every tick while Harry is in the cabinet's 40 m cell of map3_s05: set while the cabinet has not been pushed (M3S05_CabinetPushed clear), cleared once it has. While set, the spots at points 43-45 and 85 show 'There are skid marks from the cabinet being moved.' and the other message of event 96.

M3S04_LisaFmvSeen.description: Completion flag of FMV 10, played when Harry enters the examination room; it starts the Lisa scene (event 6, CutsceneHospitalLisa) and changes the lobby music state.

M3S04_LisaCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the first Lisa scene (map3_s04 CutsceneHospitalLisa, HSPTL3.DMS, Harry passes out). It starts the door event to map3_s06 (event 7).

M3S06_DahliaCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry meets Dahlia in the hospital (map3_s06 CutsceneHospitalDahlia, HSPTL2.DMS). It opens the map2_s02 door to the hospital (event 18) and changes the hospital and town music.

M3S06_PickupAntiqueShopKey.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the antique shop key on map3_s06 (Hospital - 1F after Otherworld) at map point 37 (x 95.8, z 99.8 m), event 2; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M3S06_DahliaLeftAntiqueShopKey.description: Set during the Dahlia scene in map3_s06 (or when it is skipped) when she leaves the Antique Shop Key. From then on the key is drawn on the table and can be taken (events 2 and 3).

M3S04_LisaCutsceneTalkDone.description: Set during the first Lisa scene (map3_s04 CutsceneHospitalLisa) after her line 'That's alright.', before Harry collapses. Only the lobby music mix (room 3) reads it.

M3S04_LisaCutsceneHarryCollapsed.description: Set during the first Lisa scene (map3_s04 CutsceneHospitalLisa) after Harry's collapse (step 24). Only the lobby music mix (room 3) reads it.

M3S04_FirstScareSoundPlayed.description: One-shot in map3_s04: when Harry passes x > 101.5 m and z > 59.0 m in that cell, a sound plays at (96.0, -1.2, 59.8) and the flag is set. From then on two Puppet Doctors join the map's spawn table.

M3S04_SecondScareSoundArmed.description: Set when Harry walks south of z = 100 m in the 40 m cell x 120..160 / z 80..120 of map3_s04. It arms M3S04_SecondScareSoundPlayed: walking back north of z = 104 m then plays the second sound.

M3S04_SecondScareSoundPlayed.description: One-shot in map3_s04: with M3S04_SecondScareSoundArmed armed, when Harry walks north of z = 104 m in that cell and a box at about (139-142, 98.8-99) is off screen, a sound plays at (140.5, -1.8, 98.0) and the flag is set.

M3S06_AntiqueShopKeyAndTownMapTaken.description: Set by map3_s06 every tick once both the Antique Shop Key (M3S06_PickupAntiqueShopKey) and the central town map (M2S00_PickupMap) are taken. It enables the phonebook message at point 39 (event 10), which marks the antique shop on the town map (MapMark_FogCentralTown_AntiqueWholeSign).
